drivingQuestion: How does the baraita on the twenty-year-old eunuch square with the mishna?
outcomeNote: the contradiction is resolved by Rav's restriction, supported by Rava's reading

segments.he: בַּת עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה שֶׁלֹּא הֵבִיאָה שְׁתֵּי שְׂעָרוֹת — יָבִיאוּ רְאָיָה שֶׁהִיא בַּת עֶשְׂרִים, וְהִיא הָאַיְלוֹנִית — לֹא חוֹלֶצֶת וְלֹא מִתְיַיבֶּמֶת.
segments.en: Likewise, in the case of a woman who is «twenty years old and has not developed two» pubic «hairs, they must bring proof that she is twenty years old, and» that «she is a sexually underdeveloped woman,» who «may neither perform ḥalitza nor enter into levirate marriage.» This shows that the status of a nine-year-old male and a twenty-year old man without pubic hairs are not the same, as the intercourse of a nine-year-old is considered of some significance, whereas that of a eunuch is entirely disregarded, as he may not even perform ḥalitza.

segments.he: הָא אִתְּמַר עֲלַהּ, אָמַר רַב שְׁמוּאֵל בַּר יִצְחָק אָמַר רַב: וְהוּא שֶׁנּוֹלְדוּ לוֹ סִימָנֵי סָרִיס. אָמַר רָבָא: דַּיְקָא נָמֵי, דְּקָתָנֵי: וְהוּא הַסָּרִיס. שְׁמַע מִינַּהּ.
segments.en: The Gemara answers: «Wasn’t it stated with regard to this» baraita that «Rav Shmuel bar Yitzḥak said» that «Rav said: And this» halakha applies only «if he developed» other «signs of a eunuch» by the age of twenty. The mishna, by contrast, is referring to one who merely showed the signs of maturity at a late age. «Rava said:» The language of the baraita «is also precise, as it teaches: And he is the eunuch.» One can «learn from here» that this is referring to one who is definitely a eunuch.

segments.he: וְכִי לֹא נוֹלְדוּ לוֹ סִימָנֵי סָרִיס, עַד כַּמָּה? תָּנֵי דְּבֵי רַבִּי חִיָּיא: עַד רוֹב שְׁנוֹתָיו.
segments.en: The Gemara asks a question with regard to the halakha itself: «And» in a case «where he does not develop the signs of a eunuch, until what» age is he considered a minor? «The school of Rabbi Ḥiyya taught: Until most of his years» have passed, i.e., until he reaches the age of thirty-five, i.e., halfway to seventy, the standard length of a man’s life.

segments.he: כִּי אֲתוֹ לְקַמֵּיהּ דְּרָבָא, אִי כָּחוּשׁ אֲמַר לְהוּ: זִילוּ אַבְרְיוּהּ. וְאִי בָּרִיא אֲמַר לְהוּ: זִילוּ אַכְחֲשׁוּהּ. דְּהָנֵי סִימָנִין, זִמְנִין דְּנָתְרִי מֵחֲמַת כְּחִישׁוּתָא, וְזִמְנִין דְּנָתְרִי מֵחֲמַת בְּרִיּוּתָא.
segments.en: On the same issue, the Gemara relates: «When they would come before Rava» to inquire about someone who had reached the age of maturity but had not yet developed the physical signs, «if» the person in question was «thin, he would say to them: Go» and «fatten him» up before we decide on his status. «And if he» was «fat, he would say to them: Go» and «make him thin. As these signs,» the pubic hairs of maturity, «sometimes they fall off due to thinness and sometimes they fall off due to fatness.» It is therefore possible that after his bodily shape is adjusted he will develop the signs of maturity and will not have the status of a eunuch.
